result.summary: The main visual defect is overlapping text in the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing, where the delivery fee/time/cuisine metadata lines collide and become unreadable, plus a stray strikethrough on the delivery time. Additionally, card styling is inconsistent (rounded vs. square image corners) in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: Text overlap on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' listing: the delivery info line renders on top of the delivery-time/price metadata, making both strings illegible (roughly '25–30 min delivery • Ramen' overlapping '€0 delivery').
issues.suggestion: Stack the delivery time, fee, and cuisine metadata on separate lines or give each element its own row, and ensure the containers do not overlap.

issues.description: The delivery time for the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' appears struck through, which is inconsistent with the '€0 delivery' badge and the other listings where times are shown normally.
issues.suggestion: Remove the strikethrough formatting from the delivery-time text so it reads clearly, unless the strikethrough is an intentional, clearly labeled promotion.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' image cards use inconsistent corner radii: the Tokumaru card has large rounded corners while the card below it (pizza) has square corners, making the list look visually mismatched.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same border radius (and overflow handling) to all cards in the 'Popular right now' section.
